item.title: How Indianapolis' new public editor is working to rebuild trust in local media
item.description: The Poynter Institute announced the appointment of Tracey Compton as the Indianapolis Public Editor. She will cover all newsroom that serve the city, working to rebuild trust in local media.

item.title: ICE protestors march to Gov. Braun's mansion
item.description: Hundreds of ICE protestors joined a cold, Sunday evening march on Indianapolis’ north side.

item.title: Ag bill in federal legislature could help Hoosier farmers
item.description: The bill seeks to act as a slimmed down Farm Bill, the five-year piece of legislation that sets food and agricultural policies for the country.

item.title: State dedicates 141 acres in Owen County as nature preserve
item.description: The state has dedicated 141 acres of forest land in Owen County as a nature preserve.

item.title: Remembering Indianapolis gospel songwriter and guitarist M.L. Allen Jr.
item.description: Last month, Indianapolis lost one of its great gospel music figures, the guitarist and songwriter M.L. Allen, Jr. He was 89 years old.

item.title: Fatal crashes prompt amendment that tightens commercial drivers licenses for immigrants
item.description: Indiana lawmakers want stricter CDL rules, requiring legal status and English proficiency, after fatal truck crashes. Violators could face felonies and steep fines.

item.title: Monthly vigil renews push to end ICE detention in Indiana after one immigrant dies
item.description: Multifaith leaders held their seventh vigil to oppose ICE detention at Miami Correctional Facility. The vigil comes a week after ICE immigrant detainee 59-year-old Lorth Sim died in custody at Miami Correctional.

item.title: Mayor-appointed board to assume control of Indianapolis school facilities, finances under new legislation
item.description: The Indiana Senate passed legislation, creating a mayor-appointed board to oversee IPS finances and facilities. It now heads to the governor.

item.title: INDOT announces new highway safety project
item.description: The Indiana Department of Transportation is equipping highway workers across the state with additional safety equipment to keep them safe in low-visibility conditions.

item.title: Governor could replace local bar associations in selecting Marion County judges
item.description: A bill changing how Marion County Superior Court judges are selected is creating tension between Indianapolis lawmakers.
